QuestInfo.name: The Saddest Dragon 2
QuestInfo.0: Alpha and Beta learned of a young Halflinger girl named #p2411001# in #b#m321100000##k who was an expert on music. They ventured to her in search of an instrument that would put that weepy #p2411011# to sleep, before things got any more awkward.
QuestInfo.1: #p2411001# suggested that the duo use her magical music box, a gift from #b the Fairy Queen #k, but lamented that it had been broken in a completely unavoidable on-stage smashfest. But spirits were still high, because the items needed to repair it were nearby!\r\n\r\nThe duo headed to the #bdungeon portal#k to enter the #b#MDmirrorD_321_1_##k, and find the parts.
QuestInfo.2: With the parts in hand, the duo returned to #p2411001#. The sweet lullaby maker was almost theirs!

0.0: Music's the universal language, ya know? Like I have this song I wrote called 'Filthy Forest Fire' and when I played it, everybody said the same thing! They all told me to 'stop that racket', but it was so universal and powerful.
0.1: I even got a super rare music box from the #bFairy Queen#k. I mean, I kinda smashed it on-stage at the end of my retro-electronic-post-punk-symphony, 'These Dots Are Pink And Legendary', but I bet you could fix it with the right parts.

yes.0: Maybe like... a #b#t4033798##k and a #b#t4033799##k? No, #b3#k actually. You can find those all over the place! I'd look around #b#MDmirrorD_321_1_##k first.

1.0: Oh wow! These parts will really make the low-end sing! Let me fix it up real quick.
